description:
Update metadata on a phone number — set a service label, tags, or notes.

Only provided fields are updated. Omitted fields remain unchanged.
Pass an empty array [] to clear tags, or an empty string "" to clear notes.

Examples:
  update_number("+16505551234", service_name="PayPal", tags=["production"])
  update_number("+16505551234", notes="Linked to acme@company.com")

notes.description: Free-form notes (e.g. "Linked to acme@company.com"). Max 1000 chars. Pass "" to clear.

number_id.description: Number ID (UUID) or phone number (e.g. +17243213654 or 7243213654)

tags.description: Tags for categorization (e.g. ["production", "paypal"]). Max 20 tags, 50 chars each. Pass [] to clear.

name: joltsms_update_number
